neighbours.label: the subject of a clause that ends in 'does' or 'do' for someone's job or usual action (skilled at what she does, whatever everyone else isn't doing), as opposed to the same people with a plain complement
fire: Our dentist is truly gifted at what she does.
He is the best at what he does, and he knows it.
The nurses are amazing at what they do.
Just do what everyone else isn't doing.
She loves what she does and it shows.
They are really good at what they do.
Whatever you do, he will disagree with what you do.
I am very proud of what we do here.
quiet: Our dentist is truly gifted at the violin.
He is the best in the league, and he knows it.
The nurses are amazing and funny.
Just walk with everyone else over there.
She loves her job and it shows.
They are really good at chess.
Tomorrow he will disagree with the board.
I am very proud of my son here.

notes: A plain 'What will they do' reached 0.12 in a probe; the Spanish ' lo hacen' on the card reached 0.06.
